parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This part consists of one blade and one handle of the scissors, made primarily of stainless steel for the blade and plastic for the handle grip.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as one half of the cutting mechanism and provides one of the two handles for gripping and applying force.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central screw pivot to perform the cutting motion.

parts.name: Blade Handle Set
parts.Basic_description: This part is the second blade and handle assembly of the scissors, also made of stainless steel and plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It forms the complementary half of the cutting pair, working in conjunction with the first blade to shear materials.
parts.Movement_description: It pivots around the screw joint, moving opposite to the first blade handle set to create the cutting action.

parts.name: Screw
parts.Basic_description: A small steel screw that connects the two blade-handle sets at their pivot point.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the two halves together and allows them to rotate smoothly around the pivot axis.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while allowing rotational movement of the two blade-handle sets around it.
